# Arnaud Etienne

> Software engineer from Belgium. Full-stack with a backend-heavy focus: SQL, event-driven systems (RabbitMQ), Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD. Currently a Software Engineer at Commuty.

Cares about test coverage as a tool for confidence rather than a box to tick, clean and readable solutions, mentoring, thorough code reviews and honest technical feedback. Uses AI coding assistants daily, as leverage on top of solid fundamentals.

Stack: Ruby on Rails, Quarkus (Java), JavaScript (Angular, Ionic, Ember.js), PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, AWS.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, [Commuty](https://commuty.com) (Nov 2023 – now): core parking booking features, public APIs and statistics pipelines. Rails and Quarkus services in a 10+ microservices, event-driven architecture over RabbitMQ; Angular web app on an internal component library and an Ionic mobile app; connectors between the Parking Access API and external access-control systems (Syntegro, SALTO KS…); Kubernetes with Helm, AWS infrastructure with Terraform, CI/CD.
- Lead Developer, [Squarehub](https://squarehub.eu) (Jul 2022 – Oct 2023): led the recruitment platform (product decisions, architecture, delivery); managed and coached 3 engineers; defined the product and technical roadmap; oversaw data security and compliance; handled IT hiring.
- Full-stack Developer, [Overloop](https://overloop.com) (Dec 2019 – Jun 2022): Ember.js + Rails CRM.
- Mobile Development Intern, RiseUp (Feb – May 2019): Xamarin app built from scratch.

## Education

- BSc Computer Science and Management, Institut Paul Lambin, Brussels (2015 – 2019), Cum Laude. Exchange semester at Cégep de Chicoutimi, Canada (2018).

- [Is Your Staging Environment Secure?](https://medium.com/@arnaudetienne/is-your-staging-environment-secure-d6985250f145) (2026-01-26): a personal story about discovering a public staging environment.

- [Self-Hosting Minecraft on a Raspberry Pi 5](https://medium.com/@arnaudetienne/self-hosting-minecraft-on-a-raspberry-pi-5-ff4463cdeb47) (2025-11-25): from bare Pi to a self-hosted server with backups and remote access.
